import json, re, gzip, base64, os

def run(**kwargs):
    path = kwargs.get("path", "missions/duskyr.com/extractions/tgemo_full.txt")
    out = kwargs.get("out", "missions/duskyr.com/unpacked_bundle.txt")
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
        raw = f.read()
    # find gzip base64 blobs in the bundler manifest (data field)
    blobs = re.findall(r'"data":"(H4sI[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+)"', raw)
    results = []
    for i, b in enumerate(blobs):
        try:
            data = gzip.decompress(base64.b64decode(b))
            text = data.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
            results.append(text)
        except Exception as e:
            results.append(f"[blob {i} decode error: {e}]")
    combined = "\n\n===== BLOB %d =====\n\n".join([""] + [r for r in results])
    with open(out, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(combined)
    total = sum(len(r) for r in results)
    return f"unpacked {len(blobs)} gzip blob(s), {total} chars total -> {out}"
